title: Certificate Chain of Trust
description: Interactive Mermaid hierarchy showing a PKI certificate chain from a self-signed Root CA down through intermediate CAs to end-entity certificates, with a reverse verification-path callout. Hover or tap each node for its role.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: cybersecurity
chapter_title: "Cryptography in Practice: PKI, TLS, and Data Protection"

learningObjectives: Explain how a certificate chain links an end-entity certificate to a trusted root.
Describe why intermediate CAs exist and how they limit blast radius.
Trace the reverse verification path a browser walks to establish trust.
educational.prerequisites: Basic understanding of public/private key pairs and digital signatures.

pedagogical.assessment: Discussion questions ask students to trace a chain and reason about revocation.
misconceptionsAddressed: Believing the root key signs every leaf certificate directly.
Assuming the server sends the root certificate (it sends the chain up to but not including the root).
